title: ModelManifest
description: Schema for ML model and system card static metadata and operational specifications

model_name.description: The official name or title of the model

version.description: Model version or release tag (e.g. 1.0.0, v2-preview)

release_date.description: Release or publication date (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD)

model_type.description: Category of model (e.g. LLM, Vision-Language, Dense Transformer, Mixture of Experts)

description.description: Executive summary and high-level description of the model

intended_purpose.description: Primary intended use cases, applications, and target domains

limitations.description: Known technical, context-length, factual, or capability limitations

out_of_scope_uses.description: Explicit prohibited, non-supported, or dangerous deployment scenarios

maintenance_contact.description: Contact email, team, or repository for maintenance and vulnerability reports

training_data_summary.description: Summary of pre-training datasets, curation filters, token counts, and knowledge cutoff

model_architecture.description: Architecture details such as parameter count, layers, context window, and attention mechanism

ethical_considerations.description: Safety evaluations, red-teaming insights, fairness, bias mitigation, and environmental impact

license.description: Software or weights license under which the model is distributed

citation.description: BibTeX or formal academic citation for the model

hardware_and_compute.description: Compute infrastructure, accelerators, and carbon emissions during training
